title: 第22章 蛇鳞果收服地火第23章 成功九品炼丹师
slug: 人在废丹房我九阳圣体凭丹近神
content_zh:
;;
被李安直视双眼质问，银蛇瞳孔微缩。
李安怎么知道这地火是母亲留给自己的？
甚至还知道吸收这地火，需要特殊的办法？
难不成他的灵魂已经强大到足以看透自己心中所想的地步？
银蛇忽然有些惊恐起来。
李安若是能做到这一点，那可就太恐怖了！
不过细细一想，它又迅速冷静下来，李安不可能看透自己的心思，应该是猜出来的。
但李安说得太笃定了。
要是自己依旧隐瞒，以他对火尾鼠那种狠辣的手段，以及他那谨慎的性格，只怕是会将自己抹杀在这里，然后冷酷无情的吸收掉自己的精魄！
一想到这个结果，银蛇就感觉身体越发冰冷起来。
“真是什么都瞒不过你，这地火是母亲留给我的，我是母亲死前诞生的最后一枚蛇蛋，是她最后一切的继承者。”
“吸收了这地火之后，我的血脉会再次迎来蜕变，只是地火过于凶险，吸收的办法也不同寻常。”
听到这里，轮到李安愣住了。
真有啊？！
他刚刚开始说的那么笃定，实际上不过是准备诈一诈这银蛇。
毕竟这银蛇相当不老实，之前绝对没有对自己说实话。
想不到，竟然一诈一个准！
尽管李安掌握了人阶上品的炼丹术，各方面也都有了一些提升，对收服地火也有了一些底气！
可有更稳妥的办法，自然最好。

所以，在愣了一下之后，李安的眼神就变得凝重冷冽起来，追问道：
“说说吧，到底是什么办法？”
见李安追问，银蛇犹豫了一番，还是答道：
“蛇鳞果！”
“依靠我的特殊血脉，激活特殊的蛇鳞果，就能将地火逐渐压制吸收，这里原本是有一枚蛇鳞果的，应该是被火尾鼠藏起来了。”
这种秘法，是它母亲留下的，银蛇也不知道有没有效果，但应该不会有什么问题。
李安听到这话，也就看向了火尾鼠堆放药草的地方。
那里有不少的草药、以及散发出灵气波动的灵药。
火尾鼠有囤积草药当做食物过冬的习惯，所以这里积累了不少东西。
虽然大多是草药，但种类繁多，其中零散的有一些灵药散布。
李安原本打算最后离开的时候再将这些东西装入储物袋。
那蛇鳞果既然如此重要，那就先将这些草药整理一番。
很快，李安先将那些有融合价值的药草放入到成储物袋中，然后从留在身前的灵药中，将一枚婴儿拳头大小的果子，拿在了手中。
这果子表面布满鳞片，散发出淡淡的冰凉之意，好似是冰冷的寒铁。
“对！就是这个果子！”
见李安将果子递过来，银蛇点了点头。
李安看了看蛇鳞果，又看了看银蛇。
尽管银蛇说的办法似乎很有用，灵魂波动也没有什么异常，可这办法若是有问题？
所以，李安直接从腰间摸出一把匕首，将蛇鳞果劈成了两半。
将其中一半递给了银蛇。

“你先试试这个办法！”
银蛇嘴角抽动了一下。

When Li An looked directly into his eyes and questioned him, Silver Snake's pupils shrank.
How did Li An know that this earth fire was left to him by his mother?
Do you even know that absorbing this earth fire requires special methods?
Is it possible that his soul is strong enough to see through what is in his heart?
Silver Snake suddenly became frightened.
If Ang Lee could do this, that would be terrifying!
But after thinking about it carefully, it quickly calmed down. It was impossible for Li An to see through his mind, he should have guessed it.
But Ang Lee was too sure.
If he still concealed it, with his ruthless methods towards the fire-tailed rat and his cautious character, he might have killed himself here, and then ruthlessly absorbed his essence!
Thinking of this result, Silver Snake felt his body getting colder and colder.
"I really can't hide anything from you. This earth fire was left to me by my mother. I am the last snake egg born before my mother died, and I am the last heir to her."
"After absorbing this earth fire, my bloodline will undergo transformation again. However, the earth fire is too dangerous and the method of absorption is also unusual."
Hearing this, it was Li An's turn to be stunned.
Really? !
He had spoken so confidently at the beginning, but in fact he was just preparing to deceive the silver snake.
After all, this silver snake is quite dishonest and has never told the truth to himself before.
Unexpectedly, one deceit and the other is accurate!
Although Li An has mastered the high-level human-level alchemy technique, he has made some improvements in all aspects, and he has some confidence in conquering the earth fire!
But there is a more reliable way, which is naturally the best.
Therefore, after being stunned for a moment, Li An's eyes became solemn and cold, and he asked:
"Tell me, what is the solution?"
Seeing Li An's question, Yin She hesitated for a while and finally answered:
"Snake scale fruit!"
"Relying on my special bloodline and activating the special snake scale fruit, I can gradually suppress and absorb the earth fire. There was originally a snake scale fruit here, and it should have been hidden by the fire-tailed rat."
This secret technique was left behind by its mother. Silver Snake didn't know if it would be effective, but it shouldn't be a problem.
When Li An heard this, he looked towards where the fire-tailed rats piled herbs.
There are many herbs and elixirs that emit spiritual energy fluctuations.
Fire-tailed rats have the habit of hoarding herbs as food for the winter, so a lot of things have been accumulated here.
Although most of them are herbal medicines, there are many kinds, and some elixirs are scattered among them.
Li An originally planned to put these things into storage bags when he finally left.
Since the snake scale fruit is so important, let’s sort out these herbs first.
Soon, Li An first put the herbs with fusion value into the storage bag, and then took a fruit the size of a baby's fist from the elixir left in front of him in his hand.
The surface of this fruit is covered with scales, exuding a faint coldness, like icy cold iron.
"Yes! That's the fruit!"
Seeing Li An hand over the fruit, Silver Snake nodded.
Li An looked at the snake scale fruit and then at the silver snake.
Although the method mentioned by Silver Snake seems to be very effective and there is nothing abnormal about the soul fluctuation, what if there is a problem with this method?
Therefore, Li An directly took out a dagger from his waist and split the snake scale fruit in half.
He handed half of it to Silver Snake.
"You try this method first!"
The corner of Silver Snake's mouth twitched.
